claims.claim: 图像分割缺少可直接从互联网规模化获取的掩码数据。

source_refs.excerpt: masks are not naturally abundant and thus we need an alternative strategy

claims.claim: Promptable Segmentation 将任意分割提示映射为至少一个有效掩码，从而统一预训练与零样本迁移。

source_refs.excerpt: the goal is to return a valid segmentation mask given any segmentation prompt

claims.claim: SAM 由图像编码器、提示编码器和轻量掩码解码器组成，并支持歧义提示输出多个候选掩码。

source_refs.excerpt: A heavyweight image encoder outputs an image embedding that can then be efficiently queried by a variety of input prompts to produce object masks at amortized real-time speed.

claims.claim: 模型设计同时满足灵活提示、摊销实时推理与歧义感知三项约束。

source_refs.excerpt: the model must support flexible prompts, needs to compute masks in amortized real-time to allow interactive use, and must be ambiguity-aware

claims.claim: 数据引擎依次经历辅助人工、半自动和全自动三个阶段。

source_refs.excerpt: The data engine has three stages: (1) a model-assisted manual annotation stage, (2) a semi-automatic stage with a mix of automatically predicted masks and model-assisted annotation, and (3) a fully automatic stage

claims.claim: 最终自动生成流程覆盖 11M 张图像并产出 1.1B 个高质量掩码。

source_refs.excerpt: We applied fully automatic mask generation to all 11M images in our dataset, producing a total of 1.1B high-quality masks.

claims.claim: 单前景点提示在 23 个分割数据集上产生高质量掩码，并展示多任务零样本迁移能力。

source_refs.excerpt: using a diverse new suite of 23 segmentation datasets, we find that produces high-quality masks from a single foreground point

claims.claim: 消融覆盖数据引擎阶段、图像编码器规模和训练数据规模。

source_refs.excerpt: Ablation studies of our data engine stages, image encoder scaling, and training data scaling.

claims.claim: SAM 仍可能遗漏细结构、产生小型断裂区域，并且重型图像编码器限制端到端实时性。

source_refs.excerpt: It can miss fine structures, hallucinates small disconnected components at times, and does not produce boundaries as crisply

claims.claim: SA-1B 与对比数据集都存在非洲、拉丁美洲和加勒比地区以及低收入国家代表不足的问题。

source_refs.excerpt: Images from Africa, Latin America \& Caribbean, as well as low income countries, are underrepresented in all datasets.

claims.claim: Segment Anything 的完整贡献来自任务、模型与数据三者共同设计，而非单一模型规模。

source_refs.excerpt: Our principal contributions are a new task (promptable segmentation), model (), and dataset ()
